title: Add the legacy telemetry client id to the deletion request ping
body:
### Vision statement / What / Requirements
Add the legacy telemetry client id to the deletion request ping to comply with data protection regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA) by [following the instructions for adding secondary ids to the deletion request ping.](https://mozilla.github.io/glean/book/user/pings/deletion_request.html)

This will give the user control over their tracked telemetry (linked through legacy telemetry client id) and prevent any further telemetry from being tracked for their account.

### Impact
Required by California Privacy Act deadline in June
